anchors.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
anchors.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software
anchors.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS, used to curate the dataset, not a paper describing the Spell-IT-Out data.

anchors.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
anchors.reason: EEG-BIDS is a specification/extension paper for organizing EEG data, a standard the dataset follows, not a description of the Spell-IT-Out dataset.

metadata.methods_description: EEG was recorded with a 64-channel ANT Neuro waveguard cap and eego sports amplifier at 2048 Hz (reference CPz, ground AFz, impedances below 10 kΩ), with an EOG electrode below the left eye. Data were acquired with ROS-Neuro in an electrically shielded, acoustically isolated room. Overt speech was recorded by microphone and segmented with Silero-VAD. It was aligned with the Montreal Forced Aligner and corrected manually in Praat at sentence, word and syllable level.

citation_details.title: Spell-IT-Out: data access and reproducibility code
citation_details.author: Tommaso Cortecchia, Stefano Tortora, Jeff Kiesner, Emanuele Menegatti, Luca Tonin
citation_details.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
citation_details.abstract: Code accompanying the Spell-IT-Out data descriptor. Dataset: OpenNeuro ds008968, doi:10.18112/openneuro.ds008968.v1.0.0 spellitout package: download from OpenNeuro (download_dataset), BIDS loading with lazy RunData, PhonItalia resources. reproducibility/: preprocessing pipeline (minimal processing, PyPREP channel QC, manual review GUIs, Extended Infomax ICA with ICLabel, BIDS export), syllable-level HDF5 dataset builder, and the analyses and figures of the paper.
